Jamie: Quick Q — I'm going to run a small capture to reproduce an embeddings mismatch. Plan: sample 1% of requests for 7 days. Need to include prompt context. I can redact emails/phones, but tokens/API keys might appear. Is including raw prompt allowed?
Sasha: Do not store Authorization/Bearer tokens or raw auth headers. Prompts are ok if PII-scrubbed; prefer hashing full prompt and storing a short snippet for debugging :+1:
Kevin: For model debugging, we usually keep first 200 chars of prompt (after PII scrub) + sha256 hash of full prompt. That way we can search without exposing raw text.
Mira: Agree. Also ensure the S3/object bucket uses server-side encryption, restrict IAM to sec/dev-experiments role, and set lifecycle to 7 days. Open a SEC ticket for approval and include retention and RBAC.
Jamie: Example capture snippet I'm going to save:
```
prompt_snip = prompt[:200]
prompt_hash = hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
record = {"snippet": prompt_snip, "hash": prompt_hash}
# remove auth headers before saving
headers.pop("Authorization", None)
headers.pop("X-API-KEY", None)
```
Kevin: Small requests: mask sequence IDs and any user ids in the snippet. replace emails with <redacted_email> and phone numbers with <redacted_phone>. Add a workspace opt-out flag.
Sasha: Also add a runtime toggle to stop capture immediately, and send an alert to #eng-security if the toggle is hit.
sec-bot: automated-check: captures that store raw prompts must be approved. Forbidden: Authorization, Cookie, X-API-KEY. Must use SSE encryption, least-privilege IAM role, and 7d retention. See policy: https://redwood.infr/sec/policies/logging
Jamie: Created SEC ticket SEC-4215 with config and sample logs attached. pinging @Sasha @Kevin @Mira for approvals.
Kevin: Approved for 1% sampling, 7d retention, SSE, scrub rules as above. Please paste exact regexes into SEC-4215.
Mira: Infra approved. Use STS short-lived creds for object write and enable object-level auditing.
Sasha: Security/product approved. One extra: add an allowlist of workspace IDs to exclude PII-sensitive customers.
Jamie: Will implement: snip+hash, redact regexes, workspace opt-out, runtime kill-switch + alerting. Adding regexes to the ticket and a small unit test. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
